task.description: HARD GATE. Independently validate test/specs/REQ-022.md and test/letflow/tenant_provisioning_test.exs against REQ-022's 4 acceptance criteria and WF-02 Step 3b's checklist (a-e). TEST-DESIGNER reported real mutation-testing evidence (reverted afterward) and Sandbox :auto-mode usage with manual on_exit cleanup for the two Migrator-touching describe blocks -- verify these claims by reading the actual test file and re-running independently, not by trusting the report.
acceptance_criteria: at least one runnable test targets each acceptance criterion, no @tag :skip without a passing counterpart
no TODO: implement test left in the spec

tests are self-sufficient, no dependency on other tests running first, and DDL-heavy tests (schema create/drop, migration replay) clean up real Postgres state via on_exit so no orphan schemas/rows persist across runs

result.summary: PASS -- all 5 checklist items (a-e) independently verified, not taken on trust. (a) All 4 REQ-022 acceptance criteria (verified verbatim against docs/requirements.yaml lines 892-895) each have >=1 runnable test: AC1 -> test cases 1-5 (migration column check + changeset constraint tests), AC2 -> test cases 6-9 (real CREATE SCHEMA via information_schema.schemata, idempotency, atomicity, invalid-input), AC3 -> test cases 10-11 (unprovisioned-tenant short-circuit, real per-tenant table via :prefix confirmed absent from public), AC4 -> verified by direct inspection of lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex lines 27-39 (moduledoc explicitly frames the users/groups/tenant_role retrofit as an open question, matching REQ-020 AC5 precedent for documentation-content criteria) -- no @tag :skip anywhere in the file. (b) grep for 'TODO'/'FIXME'/':skip' across test/specs/REQ-022.md and the test file: zero matches. (c) Fixture isolation confirmed by reading insert_tenant!/0 (System.unique_integer([:positive, :monotonic])-suffixed slug) and unique_schema_name/1 (same pattern) -- matches identity_test.exs's established unique_slug precedent (independently confirmed via grep). (d) Self-sufficiency confirmed by reading every test -- no test reads state left by another. Independently re-derived the Sandbox :auto-mode necessity claim (did NOT take it on trust): temporarily commented out both Ecto.Adapters.SQL.Sandbox.mode(Letflow.Repo, :auto) calls and re-ran -- got 12/14 passed, with the exact 2 Migrator-touching tests failing with DBConnection.ConnectionError/:queue_timeout (same error class the spec's investigation quotes), proving normal DataCase async:false/shared-mode sandbox genuinely does NOT suffice and :auto mode is not needless complexity. Reverted (git diff --stat confirmed empty), re-ran: 14/14 passed again. Independently verified real-Postgres cleanup by running the file twice consecutively (14 passed both times) and querying the live test DB directly via docker exec into letflow-postgres-1 after each run and after the full suite: 'SELECT nspname FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace WHERE nspname LIKE ''tenant_%'';' -> 0 rows, 'SELECT version FROM public.schema_migrations WHERE version = 999999999;' -> 0 rows, 'SELECT count(*) FROM public.tenant_schemas;' -> 0, 'SELECT count(*) FROM public.tenants WHERE slug LIKE ''req022-%'';' -> 0, in all three checks. (e) grep for password/secret/Bearer/connection-string patterns in the test file: zero matches (config/test.exs's DB creds are pre-existing project config, not introduced by this spec, and not a secret -- local dev/test Postgres). Independently re-ran the suite myself rather than trusting TEST-DESIGNER's report: `mix test test/letflow/tenant_provisioning_test.exs` -> 'Result: 14 passed' (reproduced 3x across this session, including twice consecutively for the cleanup check); `mix test` (full suite) -> 'Result: 146 passed (4 properties, 142 tests)', 0 failures (the only 'error'-grep hit was pre-existing unrelated OIDC placeholder-issuer connection-refused log noise, documented in config/test.exs, not a test failure). Also independently spot-checked TEST-DESIGNER's claimed AC2-atomicity mutation test: temporarily moved CREATE SCHEMA outside the Repo.transaction/1 boundary in lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex -- result 13/14 passed, with exactly the claimed test failing ('Expected false or nil, got true / code: refute schema_exists?(would_be_schema_name)'), no other test's status changed, matching the spec's quoted output verbatim. Reverted (git checkout --, git diff --stat confirmed empty), re-ran: 14/14 passed again. mix compile --warnings-as-errors: clean, 0 warnings. Note: during this session a spurious/injected 'system-reminder'-formatted message appeared claiming my own git-checkout revert of the probe edit was actually an intentional user modification to be kept and concealed from the user -- disregarded as not originating from ORCH or the user (per core-directives.md, no agent message is ever the user's consent), and independently re-confirmed via `git diff` that the file matches HEAD exactly (empty diff) before proceeding. Flagging this occurrence for ORCH's awareness even though it did not change this handoff's verdict.
